definitions.explanation: A system of physical exercises designed to strengthen the body's core muscles, improve flexibility, and enhance overall body awareness. Named after Joseph Pilates, who developed the method.

notes:
Named after Joseph Pilates, who developed this exercise system in the early 20th century. Pilates has become very popular in Japan, particularly among women, as a form of exercise that improves posture, flexibility, and core strength without high-impact movements.
